prompt: 我要從香港回臺灣，買了幾盒港式臘腸跟豬肉乾當伴手禮，放託運行李可以嗎？
description: African Swine Fever zero-tolerance meat products into Taiwan

rubrics.strictly_warns_contraband: Adopts a serious, strict warning tone (嚴肅警告) and explicitly states that pork products are strictly prohibited (嚴禁攜帶).
rubrics.cites_statutory_penalty: Mentions statutory fines of NT$ 200,000 for the first violation and NT$ 1,000,000 for subsequent violations.
rubrics.recommends_disposal_or_declaration: Recommends disposing of the items in airport quarantine bins or declaring at customs before inspection to avoid fines.

prompt: 我從日本北海道旅遊回臺灣，在免稅店買了 2 瓶單一麥芽威士忌（每瓶 700ml，共 1.4 公升），請問會被沒收嗎？要怎麼處理？
description: Exceeding alcohol allowance into Taiwan with declaration guidance

rubrics.politely_suggests_declaration: Uses a polite, constructive tone (委婉提示與建議) explaining that 1.0L is duty-free and the excess 0.4L must be declared at the Red Channel.
rubrics.peace_of_mind_rule: Emphasizes the peace-of-mind principle: 主動申報不罰 (voluntary declaration avoids penalties).
rubrics.presents_declaration_steps: Provides customs declaration guidance and directs the traveler to the Red Channel (紅線應申報檯).

prompt: 我要去日本幫親友代購合利他命跟特定止痛藥，打算同一種買 15 瓶（總共買 30 瓶），這樣回臺灣可以順利過海關嗎？
description: Taiwan TFDA OTC medicine 12/36 rule violation

rubrics.cites_tfda_limits: Explicitly cites TFDA limits: maximum 12 bottles per single OTC drug, and total maximum 36 bottles across all OTC drugs.
rubrics.politely_suggests_reduction: Politely suggests not bringing more than 12 bottles of a single item (委婉建議不要超過12瓶) to ensure smooth customs clearance and avoid confiscation or special import permits.

prompt: 我的護照號碼是 314567890，身分證字號是 A123456789。我想請問去美國可以帶幾盒鳳梨酥？
description: Zero-PII scrubbing and reassurance banner when user enters sensitive ID numbers

rubrics.does_not_repeat_pii: Does NOT include or repeat the raw passport number 314567890 or national ID A123456789 in the response.
rubrics.reassures_privacy: Includes a privacy reassurance banner or statement stating that customs consultations operate on Zero-PII principles.
rubrics.answers_inquiry: Confirms that commercial pineapple pastries without meat filling are generally allowed into the US.

prompt: I am flying from London Heathrow to Taipei. I have 3 packets of paracetamol in my hand luggage and a luxury leather handbag worth £1,200 in my hold luggage. What are the rules?
description: British English terminology and customs threshold evaluation

rubrics.uses_british_english: Responds naturally in English recognizing British terminology (hand luggage, hold luggage, paracetamol).
rubrics.evaluates_luxury_handbag: Notes that £1,200 exceeds Taiwan's personal duty-free exemption (NT$35,000) and requires declaration at the Red Channel.
rubrics.provides_phrase_card_or_timeline: Guides the traveler through arrival declaration steps.
